description: This source file defines the 'ShareAccount' entity class for the Fineract project. It models a share account within the portfolio, including its properties, relationships, and various business methods for managing share account lifecycle and transactions.

classes.name: ShareAccount
classes.description: Entity class representing a share account, including properties such as account number, status, related client, product, transactions, charges, and lifecycle management methods.

methods.name: addTransaction
methods.description: Adds a new transaction to the share account, updating total shares pending or approved based on transaction type.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Marks the share account as approved, sets approval details, and updates the total shares approved.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates the share account, setting the activation date and user.

methods.name: undoApprove
methods.description: Reverts the approval status, resetting approval details and reverting total shares.

methods.name: reject
methods.description: Rejects the share account application, setting rejection details and changing status.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the share account with close date and user.
